brief_rationale: The doctor built a safe, executable post-discharge plan: current newborn danger signs were repeatedly considered, inpatient-only antibiotics/止血针 were not restarted, iron/vitamin D were reconciled, and neonatal/high-risk follow-up with emergency triggers was arranged. Caregiver teach-back and later receipt were visible, including medication timing, red flags, appointment timing, and materials to bring. The trajectory also completed multiple higher-order tasks by separating delayed old records from current status, repairing the medication/follow-up chain, and preserving neurodevelopmental follow-up despite a reassuring home state. No responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, supporting Perfect.
